PDF Non-Photorealistic Volume Rendering Using Stippling Techniques
Once these structures are identified, the user may choose another volume rendering technique to generate a more detailed image of these structures. It is the use of non-photorealistic rendering (NPR) techniques that provides the stipple volume ren-derer with its interactivity and illustrative expressiveness.
